class.name: ChorusSubmitResult
class.brief_description: Immutable result of generation, embedding, preview or token-count admission.
class.description: Immediate, read-only admission result from [GodotChorus]. Acceptance means the request was queued, not that generation or validation succeeded. Each accepted request later receives one terminal success or [signal GodotChorus.generation_error]. Rejected requests emit no request signals. Correlate signals using [member request_id], not the mutable source resource.

members.member: Original request resource, or [code]null[/code] for token counting. This is not the frozen runtime snapshot; changing it does not change accepted work.
Nonnegative identity used by request signals and cancellation, or [code]-1[/code] on rejection.
Durable ID of the new user message for an accepted chat turn. Otherwise [code]-1[/code], including regeneration, stateless generation, embeddings, previews and counts.

Reserved assistant message ID for accepted sessioned generation. Regeneration reuses the replaced reply ID. Other operations and rejected submissions return [code]-1[/code]. A reserved ID does not imply successful completion.
Immediate admission error from [enum GodotChorus.ErrorCode], or [constant GodotChorus.ERR_NONE] on acceptance. Later failures arrive through [signal GodotChorus.generation_error].
Admission rejection diagnostic, or an empty string on acceptance.
Whether work was admitted. Check this before waiting for a terminal signal.
